text: {"components": [{"type": "claim", "quote": "On 1 July 2006 the Federal Act on Freedom of Information in the Administration (Freedom of Information Act) came into force.", "gist": "The Freedom of Information Act took effect on 1 July 2006."}, {"type": "claim", "quote": "Since this date, all persons have the right to access official documents from the Federal Administration, provided there are no predominant public or private interests related to the disclosure of the document that prevent this.", "gist": "From 1 July 2006, everyone has the right to access Federal Administration documents unless overriding public or private interests prohibit it."}, {"type": "claim", "quote": "This right is independent of the nationality or the domicile of the person submitting a request; and no specific reason is required.", "gist": "The right to access documents does not depend on nationality or residence, and no specific reason is needed to request it."}, {"type": "claim", "quote": "It is possible to consult documents issued after 1 July 2006.", "gist": "Documents created after 1 July 2006 can be consulted."}]}
